lines.trans: Arkasha, my dear, you are a real monster to me!
By the way, they broke a finger on my hand.
On the other hand, seventeen thousand followers appeared on the internet!
Viktor Stepanovich, when will they take off this bracelet from me?
Do not worry yourself about this bracelet.
I want to become an absolutely free person again.
Consider that you don't have it anymore.
Can you really resolve this important issue?
That is it, you are golden, there are no more problems!
Thank you very much, I appreciate your support very much.
I never forget such important services.
Come on quickly help yourself to this tasty caviar.
With pleasure I will try this wonderful black caviar!

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Настроение у меня действительно очень хорошее.
examples.trans: My mood really is very good.
This is indeed an important question.

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters

examples.trans: Don't worry yourself about the bracelet.

зато.gloss: but on the other hand, to make up for it

meanings.en: but on the other hand, at least

examples.text: Четыре по алгебре, зато по физкультуре пятёрка.
examples.trans: A four in algebra, but a five in gym.
The flat is small, but at least it's in the centre.

examples.trans: Look it up on the internet.

examples.trans: For your information, I am the chairman of the court.

между.governs: instrumental (or genitive in a few set phrases)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
